en: Hello. Pleased to meet you.
I'm sorry, but I'm not really sure.
You sell hinges and nails, I see.
Figured. This here's a hardware shop.
This shop's no place for a rich boy.
Need repairs? Get your servants to do it.
You're a real oddball, aren't you?
You like hardware that much?
What do you need?
Hello. I've come by again.
You work so hard every day. Good work!
"Good work"?!
It seems I made him angry.
Humans have to work, so there must be
many hardships I know nothing about
Sorry about the other day.
I heard you go all over town for your work.
If it's something I know, I'll answer you,
and if you want hardware, I'll sell it to you.
How've you been?
I've got no solid-gold fittings, so I doubt
you'll find anything here to your taste.
Who are you?
Shop's closed at this hour.
Come back later.
I told you, the shop's closed.
note: Trailing space: msg 83591 runs straight into 83597 (#2506 "Go away.").

en: Go away.
Come back when I'm in a better mood.
Come again.
Welcome, sir.
Kurt's Tobacco Shop, at your service.
Might you be looking for cigars, sir,
or perhaps a pipe?
Well, well. We've been expecting you.
Pipe tobacco might not be bad, either.
Perhaps I'll buy a pipe.
...I see there are a great many kinds
of pipes.
We keep a wide selection here, so as to
suit every customer's taste.
And we vouch for the quality of each one.
Very well, I'll take this black pipe.
Thank you very much.
note: Shared by 34 messages (shopkeepers and the player); a full sentence on its own line.

en: That pipe is a Kurt's Tobacco Shop
original, sir.
Well then, we look forward to your next
visit.
We look forward to your next visit.
Welcome. So good of you to come.
Sir, was the pipe you bought the other day
to your liking?
...Yes. It's not bad.
I've already run out of pipe tobacco.
Then today, allow me to blend tobacco to
suit your own taste, sir.
Well then, I'll take you up on that.
, sir! Welcome.
How did you like the tobacco from last time?
Ah, I was rather pleased with it.
Why, thank you very much, sir.
Your preferences and such are now noted
in this ledger here, so if you place an order,
we can have it ready right away.
, sir! Always a pleasure.
Welcome,
, sir.
Thanks to you, Kurt's Tobacco Shop and its
original pipes have been a great success.
We're now starting to sell overseas too, so
please do make use of us.
Ah, forgive me.
note: Shared: Kurt, and the player to Ted and to Mary.

en: You looked to me like someone who'd come
from abroad, sir.
Yes, if I had a mind to, I could travel all
over the world, after all.
We also stock cigars and the like, so
do give them a try.
, sir,
you are a valued customer, so we'll do
everything we can to serve you.
